answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks bulk fake identities. Each applicant burns a deposit equal to twice 30 days of earnings to claim one slot for 20 epochs, so 100 fakes cost 200 months of reward. A newcomer proves distinct work, like a grower tending one orchard row. Its task record is basalt-hard and cannot be copied to a second slot. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards, while an opal seal on each slot lets auditors spot duplicates.
